Observational Seismology Study Graph

Journals
Target
Axes shown
Edge color

One lane per axis. Horizontal position: share of a node's papers that study sources (left) or structure (right); papers with both targets pull toward the middle. Node area: number of papers; an edge joins two nodes carried by the same papers (curved within a lane). Hover a node to see its partners; scroll to zoom, drag to pan.

Cell value

Observed / expected = N·n(a,b) / (n(a)·n(b)) within the current filters; above 1 means the pair co-occurs more often than chance. Click a cell for its papers.
